title: Subvocal Raises $1.3M to Develop Glasses That Convert Silent Mouthing to Text
summary:
The startup Subvocal has secured early-stage funding to build a wearable interface that translates the movement of internal speech muscles into written text. The $1.3M pre-seed round was led by Afore Capital with participation from Y Combinator and angel investors, and will be used to develop smart glasses that utilize non-contact sensing to enable digital input without the need for a keyboard or audible speech.

Subvocal says the glasses can decode silent mouthing at a speed of more than 200 words per minute, which would allow users to prompt AI agents or send messages in environments where speaking aloud is impractical, such as on airplanes or in offices. The company has officially opened pre-orders for the device.
